educational.learningObjective: The learner will calculate the frequency a sampled tone appears to have, given its true frequency and the sample rate, for 6 challenge tones, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

controls: True frequency slider: 100 to 9,000 Hz in 100 Hz steps, default 1,000 Hz
Sample rate select: 4,000, 8,000, 12,800 or 16,000 Hz, default 12,800 Hz
Start challenges / Next challenge / Show score button
pedagogical.model: Samples of sin(2 pi f t) at t = n/fs; apparent frequency f if f < fs/2, fs - f if fs/2 < f < fs; the suggested wave is the phase-inverted alias, which passes through every sample.
